Sub: Draft Recruitment Rules for the post of Programmer of Information Services
Division in EPFO - reg.

Ma’amn/Sir,
As oer the guidelines issued vide DoP&T O.M. No. AB-14017/61/2008-Estt.(RR)
dated 13.10.2015, the draft Recruitment Rules for the post of Programmer of Information

Services Division in EPFO is hereby placed on the Official Website of EPFO for inviting
comments from the stakeholders.

Any suggestions/ comments/ views on the various clauses of the same alongwith
supporting DoP&T guidelines and rule position etc. may be intimated within 15 days. The
same may be sent only to the mail ID rc2.hrd@epfindia.gov.in. Comments forwarded on this
issue to any other mail id shall not be taken into consideration.

(This has the approval of CPFC)
Yours faithfully,
